rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone or something makes another person angry or annoyed.

example.english: That kind of talk can really provoke me.
example.traditional: 你咁樣講真係激嬲我喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 gong2 zan1 hai6 gik1 nau1 ngo5 wo3

rows.note: Use this when something brings about a response or reaction rather than specifically making someone angry.

example.english: This news story can provoke a reaction, and many people leave comments online.
example.traditional: 呢段新聞引起反應，網上好多人留言。
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 san1 man4 jan5 hei2 faan2 jing3 mong5 soeng6 hou2 do1 jan4 lau4 jin4
